query:
-- Senate General races with any NULL candidate
SELECT state_code, state_name, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status
FROM senate_races
WHERE status = 'General' AND (candidate1_name IS NULL OR candidate2_name IS NULL);

-- House General races with ONE null candidate (not both - those are expected for uncontested)
SELECT state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate2_name, candidate2_party, status
FROM house_races
WHERE status = 'General' AND (
  (candidate1_name IS NOT NULL AND candidate2_name IS NULL) OR
  (candidate1_name IS NULL AND candidate2_name IS NOT NULL)
)
ORDER BY state_code, district
LIMIT 30;

-- Governor races: show all 7 Voting races
SELECT state_code, dem_candidate, rep_candidate, status, notes
FROM governor_races
WHERE status = 'Voting'
ORDER BY state_code;
